message.content: During their meeting at "Central Perk" on Thursday morning, Yuriko provided valuable feedback on the demo website, suggesting that she appreciated its progress but felt the color scheme needed improvement. Specifically, she highlighted that the current color scheme reflected the gentle vibe of her studio well, but she believed it could benefit from a more vibrant or varied palette. Yuriko also proposed adding a section dedicated to community outreach programs, which she thought would effectively showcase her work and impact. Li Hua responded positively to these suggestions, agreeing that a community outreach section would indeed add significant value to the website. He expressed enthusiasm about brainstorming some ideas for this section and offered to help Li Hua with the design aspects. Li Hua further suggested adding testimonials and possibly including photos from past events to make the community outreach section more engaging and relatable. Overall, both Yuriko and Li Hua were enthusiastic about enhancing the demo website based on Yuriko's feedback, indicating a collaborative and supportive working relationship.
